snippet.title: Mayfly - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Mayfly is an eerie story-based quiet horror set aboard a narrowboat in Northern England. Upon waking alone to find your husband is missing you find yourself weaving through a shifting, unstable reality as you search your confined surroundings in this focused narrative exploration game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4057470/Mayfly/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
